sets.q: Stoick orders 7 new sails. Each sail needs 21 yards of cloth. How many yards of cloth does he need?
sets.why: 7 × 21 = (7 × 20) + (7 × 1) = 140 + 7 = 147. You can break apart the 21 too!

sets.no: First find the days in 5 weeks (5 groups of 7). Then add 4.
